description:
Doran Estates are delighted to present No. 51 Walkinstown Parade to the market. This attractive two-storey, three-bedroom home offers over 100 sq.m. of accommodation, including an extended ground floor which provides valuable additional living space.
While the property would benefit from refurbishment, it offers an excellent opportunity for a new owner to put their own stamp on the home and unlock its full potential.

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming porch leading into a bright entrance hallway. To the front is a well-proportioned living room with a feature fireplace. Double doors lead through to a separate sitting room, which can also be accessed directly from the hallway. The sitting room benefits from useful storage, while an internal window overlooking the kitchen allows additional natural light into the space.
To the rear is the kitchen and dining area, with access to a practical utility room. The utility room provides access to the downstairs bathroom and the rear garden, which offers a pleasant outdoor space and a great spot to enjoy the longer summer evenings.
Upstairs, there are two generous double bedrooms, one positioned to the front and the other to the rear, together with a single bedroom also located to the rear. The accommodation is well laid out and offers plenty of scope for improvement and modernisation.

The location is a major attraction, with Walkinstown Parade close to a wide range of local amenities including shops, schools, parks and sporting facilities. The Red Luas line is approximately a ten-minute walk away, while there are excellent bus connections to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. The M50 and N7 are both less than a five-minute drive from the property, providing convenient access to Dublin and the wider region.
No. 51 Walkinstown Parade is a property with genuine potential, offering generous accommodation, useful additional ground-floor space and a well-connected location. With the right vision and refurbishment, this home could be transformed into a fantastic property.
